## `neuro.object.defineProperty`

Static method on `Object`.

> Adds a property to an object, or modifies attributes of an existing property.

## Signatures

```ts
defineProperty(input: { o: T; p: PropertyKey; attributes: PropertyDescriptor & ThisType<any>; prompt?: string }): Promise<T>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.defineProperty` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
